summary.result: The results show that a cyclic viscoelastic-viscoplastic constitutive model can provide a good description of dynamic behavior including viscoelastic effects, within a small strain range.
summary.background: In order to estimate the viscous effects of clay over a wide range of strain levels, we confirmed the performance of a viscoelastic-viscoplastic constitutive model by simulating cyclic undrained triaxial tests to determine the cyclic strength and deformation characteristics of natural marine clay.
summary.method: Seismic response was simulated by the cyclic viscoelastic-viscoplastic constitutive model created with data recorded at Rokko Island, Kobe, Japan.

summary_ko.method: 일본 교토의 록코 섬에서 기록한 데이터를 기반으로 구성된 사이클릭 점탄성-점플라스틱 구성모델을 사용하여 지진응답을 시뮬레이션하였다.
summary_ko.result: 결과적으로 사이클릭 점탄성-점플라스틱 구성모델은 작은 변형 범위 내에서 점탄성 효과를 포함한 동적 행동을 잘 설명할 수 있음을 보여주었다.
